## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] This branch was created for a single feature or fix.
- [ ] The pull request targets `develop` for feature work.
- [ ] I tested the change locally.
- [ ] I updated docs if the workflow or behavior changed.

## Branch Rules

- Feature branches merge into `develop`.
- `develop` merges into `main` when the integrated work is ready.
